key_insight: CARES selects replay exemplars through class-aware, density-weighted coverage in a frozen pretrained feature space, avoiding continual-learner optimization signals.
engineering_relevance: CARES can reduce replay-buffer selection overhead under fixed memory budgets while maintaining competitive continual-learning accuracy.
method: Represent samples using a frozen pretrained feature extractor.
Select exemplars using class-aware, density-weighted feature-space coverage.
Construct replay buffers without learner gradients, losses, or auxiliary optimization.
evidence_signal: Across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy online class- and task-incremental evaluations, CARES reports 2.3–8.8× faster selection on Tiny-ImageNet and gains of up to 7.58 percentage points over the strongest baseline under class imbalance.
watch_item: Selection quality may depend on how well the frozen pretrained feature space represents the incoming data; code release is pending publication.
paper_title: CARES: Coverage-Aware Replay Exemplar Selection for Continual Learning
